own_solution.law: E_tot = K + 2mc^2; pc = sqrt(K^2 + 2K mc^2); E_forward = (E_tot + pc)/2
assumptions: positron annihilates in flight with the stated kinetic energy

defect_reasons.other: Tense mismatch in TEB76/TB9B8 ('gave ... before it annihilates'), and the input K is the energy on leaving the source, with no energy loss before annihilation implied rather than stated (vacuum chamber, in-flight annihilation is the clear intended reading).

notes: Certified answers verified: K=800 -> 1514.66; K=870 -> (1892 + 1282.98)/2 = 1587.49; K=930 -> (1952 + 1347.35)/2 = 1649.68; K=1040 -> (2062 + 1464.40)/2 = 1763.20 keV. Relations are correct for collinear two-photon annihilation of a moving positron on a resting electron. Minimal pairs TEB76/TE76E and TF498/TF0E4 share 130 keV and differ only in time/attachment; numeral-free twins TB9B8/TEB76 and TE53B/TF498 as described. Agrees with pass 1.
